transcript:
Interviewer: This intake is for the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: I am Cleo Bramble, and I want an existing arrangement changed before I move.
Caller: Rian Bramble is the other parent. My current address is 17 Sample Walk, Alderhaven.
Caller: We have Nola Bramble born 2011-02-12.
Caller: Our other child is Noel Bramble born 2013-08-17.
Interviewer: What are your moving plans?
Caller: I plan to move to Demo Borough on 2027-01-15 and reduce weekly travel.
Caller: The present order is dated 2020-12-02.
Caller: My requested change is: Use longer visits during school breaks.
Caller: One correction to the child information: Noel Bramble born 2013-08-18. I gave Noel the wrong day earlier; Nola is unchanged.
